column1: # kanji|keyword|mnemonic — original stories written for Kana Rush
言|say|A mouth (口) at the bottom with lines of words rising out of it like steam: that's what it looks like when you say something.
事|thing, matter|A hand holding a brush vertically through a stack of papers: every official matter, every thing, gets filed on a spike.
無|nothing|A dancer twirling over a fire (灬) until her whole troupe is burned away and there's nothing left.
居|be (present), reside|Someone sits (尸 a body bent over) on an old (古) chair, where they've resided forever. They're always present.
有|have, exist|A hand (ナ) holding meat (月): if you have meat in hand, you have everything you need.
俺|I (rough, male)|A person (亻) puffing himself up big (大) with a lightning bolt (电) in his chest: "ORE!" The swaggering "I".
来|come|A tree (木) with arms flung out wide, waving everyone over: come here!
良|good|A dog-eared drop (丶) on top of a hardworking plow: a good, reliable tool that does good work.
何|what|A person (亻) staring at a can (可) with no label: "What's inside? What is this?"
思|think|A field (田) sitting on top of a heart (心): the farmer thinks about his crops with his whole heart.
行|go|Two crossroads streets side by side (彳 and 亍): take one and go.
見|see|A giant eye (目) walking on two legs (儿): all it does is go around seeing things.
物|thing, object|A cow (牛) next to a fluttering flag (勿): at the market every thing, even a cow, has a price flag on it.
私|I, private|Grain (禾) next to an elbow (厶) hugging it close: "This is MY rice. Private." The polite "I".
出|exit, go out|Two mountains (山) stacked: to get out of the valley you have to climb out over both.
分|divide, minute, understand|A sword (刀) splitting something in eight (八): divide it into pieces and suddenly you understand.
一|one|A single horizontal line. One.
時|time, hour|The sun (日) next to a temple (寺) with a bell that rings on the hour: time.
人|person|A person walking: two legs striding apart.
今|now|A roof (人) over a single line and a hook: duck under it right NOW.
中|middle, inside|A line stabbing straight through the middle of a box (口).
自|self, oneself|A nose (目 with a dot on top): when you point at yourself, you point at your nose.
気|spirit, energy, air|Steam (气) rising off a pot of rice (メ): the energy and spirit in the air.
手|hand|A hand with its fingers spread out and the wrist below.
目|eye|An eye turned on its side: the frame with the pupil lines inside.
聞|hear, ask|An ear (耳) pressed against a gate (門): hearing what's said on the other side.
効|effect, be effective|Exchange (交) your strength (力) for results: hard work starts to take effect.
前|before, in front|Horns (丷) on a boat (月) with a knife (刂) at its prow: it cuts the water in front.
顔|face|A standing (立) man with a fancy beard (彡) and a big head (頁): that's his face.
方|direction, way, person (polite)|A person with a flag on their head, pointing the way: "This direction!"
訳|translation, reason|Words (言) passed under a ruler (尺) to measure their meaning: translation, and the reason behind it.
僕|I (boyish)|A person (亻) carrying a heavy load of chores: the humble servant boy who says "boku".
考|think, consider|An old man (耂) bent over with a cane, deep in thought, considering.
知|know|An arrow (矢) shot straight into a mouth (口): knowledge hits fast and sticks.
話|talk, story|Words (言) flowing off a tongue (舌): talking, telling a story.
持|hold, have|A hand (扌) holding the temple (寺) keys: you hold onto what you have.
声|voice|A samurai (士) shouting through a doorway (尸 shape): his voice carries.
後|after, behind|Someone walking (彳) with tiny thread steps (幺) and dragging feet (夂): always lagging behind, coming after.
二|two|Two chopsticks laid side by side on the table: two.
少|a little, few|Small (小) with a slash cutting a bit off: now it's even fewer.
彼|he, that|A man walking (彳) wearing an animal skin (皮): "Look at HIM over there."
女|woman|A woman kneeling gracefully with her arms crossed.
葉|leaf|Grass (艹) on top of a tree (木) with an era (世) between: leaves, generation after generation.
入|enter|A person ducking (a lopsided 人) as they enter a low doorway.
本|book, origin, real|A tree (木) with a line marking its root: the origin. Books are made from trees.
当|hit, right, this|A small (⺌) arrow hitting a target (ヨ): spot on, that's right.
使|use|A person (亻) acting as an official (吏): they're used to run errands.
取|take|A hand (又) grabbing an ear (耳): warriors took enemy ears as trophies.
撮|take (a photo)|A hand (扌) gathering everyone together (最 the most): "Everybody in! Click." Taking a photo.
採|pick, gather|A hand (扌) with a claw (爫) reaching into a tree (木): picking fruit.
誰|who|Words (言) next to a little bird (隹): "Who's tweeting?"
置|put, place|A net (罒) laid straight (直) on the ground: put it right there.
上|up, above|A line pointing up from the ground.
三|three|Three chopsticks stacked, the middle one shortest: three.
未|not yet|A tree (木) with a short top branch: it's not yet fully grown.
体|body|A person (亻) standing like a book (本) with a straight spine: the body.
間|interval, between|The sun (日) shining between two gate doors (門): the gap between.
掛|hang, cost|A hand (扌) hanging fortune-telling sticks (卦) on a hook.
賭|bet, gamble|A shell (貝, money) slapped down by a person (者): placing a bet.
作|make|A person (亻) with a saw, making something (乍).
男|man|Power (力) in the rice field (田): the man doing the heavy farm work.
違|differ, be wrong|Walking (辶) around a leather (韋) shop the wrong way: it's different from what you expected.
又|again, also|A hand reaching out again and again.
日|sun, day|The sun, drawn as a box with a line through it. One sun, one day.
頭|head|Beans (豆) piled on a big head (頁): your head is full of beans.
口|mouth|An open mouth, drawn as a square.
悪|bad, evil|An ugly (亜) heart (心): evil.
直|straight, fix|Ten (十) eyes (目) looking dead straight ahead along a ruler: keep it straight, fix it.
力|power, strength|A flexed arm showing its power.
付|attach|A person (亻) with a hand (寸) sticking something onto them: attach.
強|strong|A bow (弓) and a big bug (虫) with a mouth (ム): a bug strong enough to string a bow.
待|wait|Walking (彳) up to the temple (寺) and waiting in line.
緒|cord, together|Thread (糸) tying a person (者) to others: all together.
戻|return|A door (戸) with a big (大) dog running back through it: return.
同|same|A frame with one mouth (口) inside, under one roof: everyone says the same thing.
皆|all, everyone|A comparison (比) of everyone's white (白) robes: all alike.
凄|amazing, terrible|Ice (冫) and a wife (妻): a chill that's amazing and terrible at once.
姿|figure, appearance|Next (次) to a woman (女): her figure turns heads.
部|part, section|Standing (立) with a mouth (口) and a village (阝): each section of town.
屋|roof, shop|A body (尸) arriving (至) under a roof: a house, a shop.
相|mutual, each other|A tree (木) and an eye (目) watching each other.
帰|return home|A broom (帚) and a blade (刂): sweep up and return home.
代|substitute, era, fee|A person (亻) with a stake (弋): stand in for someone, generation after generation.
換|exchange|A hand (扌) swapping goods (奐): exchange.
返|return (something)|Walking (辶) back with a reversed (反) direction: give it back.
世|world, generation|Three tens (十) joined together: thirty years, a generation of the world.
界|world, boundary|A field (田) with a boundary (介) around it: your world.
食|eat, food|A roof (人) over a good (良) meal: eat.
早|early|The sun (日) on top of ten (十): up early.
速|fast|Walking (辶) carrying a bundle (束): hurry, fast.
問|question|A mouth (口) at the gate (門) asking questions.
題|topic, title|A big head (頁) that's right (是) on topic: the title.
必|must, certainly|A heart (心) slashed through: it certainly must happen.
要|need, main point|A woman (女) under a lid (覀): what she needs is the main point.
変|change, strange|A red (亦) foot (夂) trying to change direction: strange.
子|child|A child with arms outstretched.
大|big|A person with arms stretched out wide: this big!
者|person, someone|An old person (耂) with the sun (日) on them: someone.
場|place|Earth (土) in the sun (昜): a place.
所|place|A door (戸) and an axe (斤): the place where you chop wood.
確|certain, confirm|A stone (石) and a crane-like bird (隺) standing firm on it: solid, certain, confirmed.
意|mind, meaning|A sound (音) coming from the heart (心): what you really mean.
味|taste|A mouth (口) chewing a fruit that's not yet (未) ripe: taste it.
過|pass, excess|Walking (辶) past a bony skeleton (咼): you've gone too far, past the limit.
他|other|A person (亻) next to someone else (也): the other one.
通|pass through, commute|Walking (辶) through a tube (甬): pass through, commute every day.
先|ahead, previous|A person on legs (儿) with a sprout on their head, out in front: ahead.
丈|length, sturdy|A big man with a staff (一 and 㐅): tall and sturdy.
夫|husband, man|A big (大) man with a hairpin bar across his head: a grown man, a husband.
駄|useless, pack-horse|A horse (馬) that's too fat (太) to carry anything: useless (as in 駄目).
呼|call|A mouth (口) shouting "Ho!" (乎): calling someone.
心|heart|A heart with drops of blood around it.
別|separate, another|A mouth (口) over power (力) cut by a knife (刂): split apart, separate.
下|down, below|A line pointing down from the ceiling.
全|whole, all|A king (王) under a roof (人): everything under his roof, the whole lot.
好|like, fond of|A woman (女) holding a child (子): what she loves most.
始|begin|A woman (女) and a platform (台): she steps up and the show begins.
向|face toward|A window in a house with a mouth (口) facing out: face toward.
家|house, family|A roof (宀) over a pig (豕): in old times the family pig lived under the house roof.
受|receive|A claw (爫) hand passing something down to another hand (又): receive.
次|next|Ice (冫) beside a yawn (欠): it's cold and boring, next!
続|continue|Thread (糸) being sold (売) by the meter: it just keeps going.
因|cause|A big (大) person boxed in (囗): there's a cause for being trapped.
笑|laugh|Bamboo (竹) bending over like a person bent (夭) laughing.
供|offer, companion|A person (亻) holding things together (共) to offer them.
内|inside|A person (人) stepping inside a frame (冂).
欲|desire, want|A valley (谷) and a yawning mouth (欠): an emptiness you want to fill.
多|many|Two evenings (夕) stacked up: many nights.
終|end, finish|Thread (糸) running into winter (冬): the year's yarn comes to an end.
仕|serve, do|A person (亻) serving as a samurai (士): to serve, to do work.
以|by means of|A person (人) using a plow-like tool: by means of this.
四|four|A box with legs inside: the four-sided room.
五|five|A spool with a cross through it, standing on its base: five.
立|stand|A person standing on the ground with arms out.
建|build|A hand holding a brush (聿) stretched out along a long stride (廴): drawing the long blueprint to build.
音|sound|Someone standing (立) at sunrise (日) ringing a bell: the first sound of the day.
感|feeling|A shout so loud that all (咸) hearts (心) feel it.
得|gain, can|Walking (彳) to the pay window, where a hand (寸) gives you a day's (日) wages: gain.
動|move|Heavy (重) things need power (力) to move.
余|surplus, extra|A big roof (人) over a small table (朩) with room to spare: surplus.
切|cut|Seven (七) quick slices with a knife (刀): cut.
嬉|glad, happy|A woman (女) beating the festival drum (喜): she's glad.
零|zero|Rain (雨) obeying the order (令) to stop: drip, drip, down to zero.
様|Mr./Ms., manner|A tree (木), a sheep (羊) and a stream (水): the elegant way a proper estate looks.
死|death|A bare skeleton (歹) beside a person collapsed on a spoon-shaped knee (匕): death.
教|teach|An old teacher (耂) holding a child (子) by the hand while tapping a stick (攵): teach.
高|tall, expensive|A tall tower with a roof, a window and a door: tall, and expensive to build.
表|surface, express|Clothes (衣) with a fancy top layer on show: the surface everyone sees.
情|emotion|A heart (忄) that's turned blue (青): raw emotion.
会|meet|A roof (人) over two (二) people, elbows (ム) touching: a meeting.
遭|encounter|Walking (辶) straight into a gang of officials (曹): an unlucky encounter.
嫌|dislike|A woman (女) forced to hold two things at once (兼): she hates it.
済|finish, settle|Water (氵) poured until it's perfectly level (斉): all settled, finished.
歩|walk|Stop (止), then a few short steps (少): walking.
開|open|Two gate doors (門) with the bar (开) lifted out: open.
番|number, turn|Seeds scattered (釆) over a rice field (田): each plot gets a number and a turn.
身|body|A pregnant body seen from the side, belly out: the body.
答|answer|Bamboo (竹) slips that fit together (合): the answer fits the question.
関|barrier, connection|A gate (門) with a heavenly lock (关) on it: a checkpoint, a connection.
係|in charge, connection|A person (亻) holding the family thread (系): the one in charge of the ties.
最|most|Under the sun (日), taking (取) the most you can.
君|you (familiar)|A ruler's hand (尹) over a mouth (口) pointing: "Hey, you!"
理|reason, logic|A king (王) laying out a village (里) street by street: logic.
由|reason, from|A rice field (田) with a sprout poking out of the top: where it all comes from.
可|possible, can|A mouth (口) tucked under a nail (丁): "Yes, it can be nailed."
能|ability|A bear (ム over 月) with two sets of claws (匕匕): it can do anything.
存|exist, know|A child (子) sheltered under a ledge: it exists, I know about it.
在|exist, be at|A person leaning on a stick over the earth (土): here they are.
胸|chest|Flesh (月) wrapped (勹) around bad luck (凶): you clutch your chest when things go wrong.
普|general, ordinary|The sun (日) over people standing side by side (並): ordinary days.
合|fit, match|A lid (人) on a box (口) with a line: they fit together.
止|stop|A foot planted on the ground: stop.
初|first|Clothing (衤) cut with a knife (刀): the first step in making clothes.
足|foot, enough|A knee (口) on a leg (止-like): foot. Enough walking.
頃|time, about|A spoon (匕) beside a big head (頁): around that time.
名|name|An evening (夕) mouth (口): in the dark you call out your name.
首|neck|A head with hair on top: neck.
既|already|Food on a plate (艮) and a person turned away (旡): already finished eating.
状|state, condition|A bed (丬) with a dog (犬): the state of things.
況|situation|Water (氵) and an older brother (兄): the situation is getting wet.
飲|drink|Food (食) and a yawning mouth (欠): drink up.
頂|top, receive|A nail (丁) on top of a head (頁): the summit.
離|leave, separate|A bird (隹) flying away from a weird beast (离): separate.
生|life, raw, birth|A cow (牛) on the ground (一): life springs up.
長|long, leader|Long hair flowing: the leader with long hair.
母|mother|A woman with two breasts.
外|outside|Evening (夕) and divination (卜): the fortune teller works outside.
頑|stubborn|A head (頁) that's the original (元): stubborn.
張|stretch|A bow (弓) that's long (長): stretch it.
残|remain, leftover|Bones (歹) and two halberds (戈): the leftovers of a battle.
書|write|A brush (聿) over the sun (日): write.
兄|older brother|A big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the big brother.
驚|surprise|Respect (敬) and a horse (馬): a startled horse.
覚|remember, wake|A small (⺌) crown seeing (見): you wake up and remember.
腕|arm|Flesh (月) and a curled-up person (宛): your arm.
色|color|A person (⺈) crouching over a snake (巴): colorful skin.
守|protect|A roof (宀) and a hand (寸): protect.
水|water|A stream in the middle with splashes flying off both sides: water.
走|run|Earth (土) and a foot (止-like): run.
振|shake, wave|A hand (扌) and a dragon (辰): shake.
配|distribute, worry|Sake (酉) poured out for oneself (己) and everyone: distribute it, and worry nobody's left out.
忘|forget|Death (亡) of the heart (心): it's gone from your mind. Forget.
度|degree, times|A cliff-house (广) full of twenty (廿) hands (又) measuring: degrees, how many times.
小|small|A tiny hook with a drop on each side: small.
態|condition, attitude|An able (能) heart (心): your attitude shows your condition.
報|report, reward|Happiness (幸) and a kneeling person grabbed by a hand (𠬝): the news is reported, the reward paid.
愛|love|A claw (爫) covering (冖) a heart (心) as it walks away (夂): love you can't let go of.
国|country|A king's jewel (玉) inside borders (囗): the country.
願|request, wish|An original (原) head (頁): from the bottom of your head, a wish.
程|extent, degree|Grain (禾) presented (呈) for measure: to what extent?
楽|fun, easy, music|A tree (木) with white (白) bells hanging on it: music and fun.
買|buy|A net (罒) over shells (貝, money): scoop up money to buy things.
殺|kill|Bound (乂) and struck down by a tree (木) and a club (殳): kill.
更|again, more|A day (日) crossed out and redone: once more.
性|nature, sex|A heart (忄) you're born (生) with: your nature.
絶|absolutely, cut off|Thread (糸) cut by a colored (色) blade: cut off, absolutely.
対|opposite, versus|Text (文) against an inch (寸): face off against.
辞|quit, word|A tongue (舌) and something bitter (辛): bitter words when you quit.
夜|night|A person (亻) under a roof with the evening (夕) moon: night.
特|special|A cow (牛) at the temple (寺): a special offering.
困|trouble|A tree (木) trapped in a box (囗): stuck, in trouble.
引|pull|A bow (弓) and its string (丨): pull back.
馬|horse|A horse with its mane flying and four legs (灬).
鹿|deer|A deer under a shelter (广) with antlers and legs.
回|times, turn around|A box inside a box: going round and round.
乗|ride|A tree (木) with a person straddling it: ride.
光|light|Fire on a person's head (儿): shining light.
形|shape|A frame (开) with three hair strokes (彡): shape.
共|together|Two hands holding something up together.
奥|interior, wife|Rice (米) stored deep inside a big (大) house: the back of the house.
優|gentle, superior|A person (亻) full of sorrow (憂) for others: gentle, kind.
腰|waist, lower back|Flesh (月) that's essential (要): your lower back.
頼|rely on|A bundle (束) carried on a head (頁): rely on someone to carry it.
深|deep|Water (氵) under a cave roof with a tree: deep.
進|advance|A bird (隹) walking (辶) forward: birds can't walk backwards. Advance.
神|god|An altar (礻) with lightning striking down (申): god.
説|explain, theory|Words (言) from a brother (兑) with horns: explain.
明|bright|Sun (日) and moon (月) together: bright.
結|tie, conclude|Thread (糸) tied by a samurai's (士) mouth (口): tie up, conclude.
果|fruit, result|A field (田) on top of a tree (木): fruit, the result.
決|decide|Water (氵) bursting through a dam (夬): decide.
読|read|Words (言) for sale (売): read them.
逃|escape|Walking (辶) away from omens (兆): escape.
怖|scary|A heart (忄) wrapped in cloth (布): scared.
元|origin, former|Two (二) lines balanced on a pair of legs (儿): the original two-legged ancestor everyone came from.
瞬|blink, instant|An eye (目) beside a dancing emperor (舜): he spins so fast you'd miss it in a blink.
店|shop|A fortune-teller (占) set up under a lean-to roof (广): the first little shop in town.
軽|light (in weight)|A cart (車) piled with nothing but a tiny clod of earth (圣): it's so light it rolls by itself.
我|I, self|A hand (手) gripping a halberd (戈): "I'll defend myself!"
六|six|A little hat on a table with two splayed legs: six.
肩|shoulder|A door (戸) hinged onto flesh (月): your shoulder is the door your arm swings from.
解|solve, untie|A knife (刀) carving a cow (牛) apart at the horn (角): take it apart and the puzzle's solved.
探|search|A hand (扌) groping into a deep, dark cave (罙): searching for something.
起|wake up, rise|Run (走) because it's you yourself (己) who's late: wake up and get up!
御|honorable|Walking (彳) up to the lord with a kneeling person (卩) and gifts (午 + 止): the honorable approach.
免|excuse, avoid|A person with a rabbit-like head (⺈) slipping out on legs (儿): "Excuse me!" and they've avoided it.
寝|sleep|Under the roof (宀), on a bed (丬), sweeping (帚) your worries away: time to sleep.
辺|vicinity, area|Walking (辶) around carrying a knife (刀): marking out the area around here.
与|give|A hand holding out a hooked gift: give.
落|fall, drop|Grass (艹) and water (氵) and each (各) leaf: every leaf drops into the stream.
識|knowledge, discern|Words (言), sounds (音) and a halberd (戈): knowledge sharp enough to tell things apart.
空|sky, empty|A hole (穴) punched by a craftsman (工): look through it and there's only empty sky.
簡|simple, brief|Bamboo (竹) slips with gaps (間) between: ancient notes, written simple and brief.
単|single, simple|A sling-shot with two ears on top, firing one (single) shot at a time.
認|recognize, admit|Words (言) said while enduring (忍) a blade over the heart: admit it, I recognize it.
消|erase, put out|Water (氵) poured on a small (⺌) moon (月) of flame: put it out, erase it.
連|take along, connect|Walking (辶) beside a cart (車), linked together: take someone along.
伝|convey, transmit|A person (亻) passing along what was said (云): convey the message.
現|appear, present|A jewel (王) that you can now see (見): it's appeared, right here in the present.
息|breath|Your self (自, a nose) above your heart (心): breath goes in through the nose to the heart.
指|finger, point|A hand (扌) reaching for something delicious (旨): point at it with your finger.
料|fee, ingredients|Rice (米) scooped with a dipper (斗): the ingredients, measured out and paid for.
許|permit, allow|Words (言) at high noon (午): the boss announces at midday that it's allowed.
耳|ear|An ear drawn tall, with its folds inside.
奇|strange, odd|A big (大) person who says "can do" (可) to everything: strange.
麗|lovely, beautiful|A deer (鹿) wearing a pair of elegant ornaments on its antlers: lovely.
七|seven|A cross with its tail kicked up like a 7 upside down: seven.
近|near|Walking (辶) up to an axe (斤): too near!
完|complete|A roof (宀) finally on the original (元) frame: the house is complete.
非|not, wrong|Two wings beating in opposite directions: it can't fly. Not.
常|usual, always|A small (⺌) roof over a mouth (口) and a cloth (巾): the usual tablecloth, always there.
座|seat|Two people (人人) sitting on the ground (土) under a roof (广): seats.
反|anti, reverse|A hand (又) pushing back against a cliff (厂): reverse.
応|respond|A heart (心) under a roof (广) that answers when someone knocks: respond.
戦|war, battle|A single (単) slingshot against a halberd (戈): war.
夢|dream|Grass (艹) over an eye (罒) closed (冖) for the evening (夕): dreaming in a meadow at night.
輩|fellow, comrade|Not (非) a carriage (車) but a row of them: all your fellows, lined up.
実|truth, fruit|Under the roof (宀) the husband (夫) shows what three (三) real fruits he grew: truth.
際|occasion, edge|A hill (阝) with a festival (祭) at its edge: on the occasion.
難|difficult|A bird (隹) trying to land on a crumbly clay pile: difficult.
選|choose|Walking (辶) past two snakes (巳巳) and a table of offerings (共): choose carefully.
求|request, seek|A hand reaching for scattered water drops: seeking.
八|eight|Two strokes splitting apart: eight.
準|standard, semi-|A bird (隹) standing on ten (十) over water (氵): a level, a standard.
